usedFor: DragApp turns Gmail into a team board, where “Create Card” adds work and “New Task Cards” picks up cards.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Card” in DragApp
bestTemplate.why: A new booking becomes a card with a title and column on a Drag board.

watchOut: “New Task Cards” in DragApp is polling and reads a time window, so cards are picked up on a schedule.
